from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """An expense entry found in a company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label for the expenses (e.g., 'Selling, general and administrative')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric magnitude of the expense amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data (e.g., 'three-month period ended March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the text containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_entries: list[CompanyExpense]
